thread:
ravi: Noticed followups drifting again. Proposal: tight 5-step remediation rhythm + lightweight recurrence signal. Quick paste.

maggie: paste pls

ravi: TL;DR:

```
1) T+24h: assign primary + backup (include rollback owner)
2) T+72h: remediation scope + test plan
3) T+7d: status update (green/yellow/red) + blockers
4) T+21d: QA/regression + ops doc edits
5) T+45d: closure review + metrics check
Recurring rule: 2 similar incidents in 60d -> escalate to SRE lead and schedule 90min pattern review.
```

sam: add calendar reminders, CSV export, and Console widget for open actions.

olga: IC rotation idea: 1 week IC + named backup. New IC covers followups for first 48h to avoid owner gaps.

incident-bot: I can scaffold followups: `/incident followup create --owner @ravi --backup @maggie --due 7d --tags remediation` and will DM at T+24h and T+7d.

maggie: I'll run a 4-week pilot with current oncall and track: %assigned<24h, median assign time, overdue %. Will post weekly notes.

ravi: thanks—I'll update the runbook and drop the short checklist in #eng-oncall before Monday.
